votes.motion: Approve the Meeting Minutes of September 10, 2024 and October 8, 2024
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from the September 10 and October 8, 2024 RDA Board meetings.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 21 of 2024 – Rio Grande District Vision and Implementation Plan
votes.description: The Board adopted a resolution approving the Rio Grande District Vision & Implementation Plan, which covers approximately eleven RDA-owned acres in the Depot District Project Area and envisions transit-oriented development with new streets, public open spaces, upgraded utilities, and a shared parking structure.
